turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on much and many?
turns.tutor:
The rule: use many with things we can count (books, cars) and much with things we cannot count (milk, money).
Right: "How many ducks are on the lake?"
Wrong: "How much ducks are on the lake?" Ducks can be counted, so much does not fit.
I show you one: "The desert does not get much rain." Rain cannot be counted, so much.
Your turn. Write much or many:
How ___ bottles are there?
